column1: # Rows db.xc.* (line RG, item X-chunk, 2026-11-18): BLASTN BATCH_SIZE=1 with CHUNK_SIZE and OVERLAP_CHUNK_SIZE pairs that leave a query chunk without a query (tests/fasta/outfmt0/xch_*.fna, tests/db_search/make_xchunk_inputs.py): NCBI's CQuerySplitter::Split makes every chunk's query factory before any chunk is set up and dereferences the missing query vector of a chunk that no query reaches (split_query_cxx.cpp:234-249,876-880): a null-pointer CCoreException, exit 3, after the reports of the query batches before; LOSAT writes those reports, then refuses (the rows are rejection rows whose stdout_sha256 and stdout_bytes are NCBI's stdout, frozen with db_search_fixtures.py freeze). The row .gaps. is LOSAT's explicit rejection of a negative pair whose chunk ranges leave gaps (PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS rule 3), which NCBI searches (exit 0).
